On The 29th Of December, 2025

 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Vimal Kumar Gangwal - Advocate for the applicant
 Shri Viraj Godha - Govt. Advocate for the respondent/
 Order

1. This first bail application under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (equivalent to Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the applicant Shailu @ Shailesh for grant of regular bail, who has been arrested on 16.11.2025 in connection with Crime No.502/24 registered at Police Station Deendayal Nagar, Ratlam (M.P.) for commission of offences under Sections 363,
376(2)(n), 376(3) of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
2. The allegation against the applicant is that he has abducted the prosecutrix and committed rape upon her.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the crime.
There is no legal evidence to connect the applicant with the aforementioned crime.
Applicant is aged about 19 years.
He is permanent resident of District Banswada.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:37922 2 MCRC-60159-2025

Conclusion of the trial will take considerable long time, therefore, learned counsel prays for grant of bail.
4.
Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State has vehemently opposed the prayer and prays for dismissal of the bail application.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.
Looking to the totality of facts and circumstances of the case, this Court deems it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.

Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the Shailu @ Shailesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 29 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119922499/
1 application is allowed.
